entries.title: Your first mate can run a series of tasks as one program
entries.body: When work repeats over many files, or each piece depends on the last one's result, the first mate can write it as one program. Each piece shows as a task of its own under the program, and the program passes each result on to the next. Before a large program starts, the first mate asks you how many tasks it may run, and asks again before it runs more.
entries.noPicture: A program shows as an ordinary task with its pieces as child tasks, and its questions are cards the first mate writes, so there is no new view.
